text.p: These are the leading stories in the Algerian press on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Security forces kill eight "terrorists" in a raid in central Algiers.
- Workers' Union Generale des Travailleurs Algeriens (UGTA) names Abdelmajid Sidi Said as the union acting head to replace slain Abdelhak Benhamouda.
- Security forces "eliminate" members of an Armed Islamic Group (GIA) splinter faction.
- The authorities plan new measures to spur activity in ports.
- President Liamine Zeroual to meet more political parties and unions to discuss preparations for parliamentary elections planned for the first half of this year.
- Security forces shot dead eight "terrorists" in a spectacular operation in Algiers.
- Security forces kill "terrorists" suspected of being the murders of UGTA's general secretary Abdelhak Benhamouda.
